 Your guide to all the concerts and festivals happening just around the corner.
 Photos: Kevin Mazur / Getty Images Entertainment / Getty Images and Courtesy of Live Nation SingaporePhotos: Kevin Mazur / Getty Images Entertainment / Getty Images and Courtesy of Live Nation Singapore By  Jolin Lam, Ynez Loh, Laila Mishazira and Nicole Ng  -  published 29 Oct 2026 
 When life gives you lemons, then you should know it’s high time to attend a concert. Whether it’s because your favourite musician is in town, or you just need to sing your lungs out with hundreds of fellow concertgoers, having a concert or festival to look forward to can make your week that much more bearable . For those trawling the internet to find out what concerts are happening in Singapore and when they’re arriving, keep scrolling.
 Related article: All The Upcoming K-Pop Comebacks To Keep An Eye Out For 
 2 November 2026: Benson Boone - Wanted Man Tour
 Benson Boone took the world by storm with his hit single “Beautiful Things” in 2024. Now, he is bringing his powerful, enchanting vocals to Singapore. Known for exhilarating shows that blend soaring vocals with acrobatic flair, his performance promises to be an unforgettable experience.
 Where: The Star Theatre
 When: 2 November 2026
 Tickets are available on Ticketmaster. 
 3 November 2026: yung kai - stay with the ocean, i’ll find you: asia tour 2026 in Singapore
 Alternative indie-pop artist yung kai makes his long-awaited return to Singapore this November. Fans can look forward to a night of smooth, soothing melodies featuring his beloved hits such as “blue” and “wildflower”.
 Where: Capitol Theatre
 When: 3 November 2026
 Tickets are available on Ticketmaster. 
 4 November 2026: LANY - soft world tour
 If you’re into indie pop, you might want to get in on this. In light of their Soft 2 album release, LANY will be returning to Singapore’s Indoor Stadium. This will be Paul Klein (lead vocalist, guitarist) and Jake Goss ’ (drummer) seventh time performing in Singapore, and it’s clear the love between the band and their fans here is mutual.
 Where: Singapore Indoor Stadium
 When: 4 November 2026
 Tickets are available on Ticketmaster . 
 10 and 11 November 2026: My Chemical Romance - Live in Singapore
 MCRmy, the military jackets and eyeliner are calling. My Chemical Romance ’s world tour sees a sold-out Singapore leg, marking their return here for the first time in over a decade. Come ready to jam out to classics like “Welcome to the Black Parade” and “Famous Last Words”, as well as a series of ballads and more.
 Where: Singapore Indoor Stadium
 When: 10 and 11 November 2026
 Tickets are sold out on Sistic . 
 16 November and 3 December 2026: 5SOS - Everyone’s A Star! Tour
 Photo: Courtesy of Live Nation Singapore Pop rock is so back, baby! Say hello again to everyone’s favourite Australian boy band, 5 Seconds of Summer. After eight long years, they’ve finally making their way back to Singapore. Besides tracks from their latest album, expect them to electrify the stage with their major hits like “She Looks So Perfect” and “Youngblood”. We’re getting goosebumps just thinking about it.
 Where: The Star Theatre
 When: 16 November and 3 December 2026
 Tickets are available on Ticketmaster . 
 20 November 2026: wave to earth - the pieces tour
 Indie rock band wave to earth , consisting of lead singer and guitarist Daniel Kim , bassist John Cha and drummer Shin Dong Gyu , is coming back to our shores. As part of their 0.03 tour last year, they killed the stage with songs like “play with earth!”, “peach eyes”—the list goes on. Did we also mention Daniel’s insane solo shreds? We can’t wait to witness that again this year.
 Where: Singapore Indoor Stadium
 When: 20 November 2026
 Tickets are available on Ticketmaster . 
 21 and 22 November 2026: JOJI - Solaris World Tour
 Japanese Australian singer-songwriter JOJI aka @sushitrash will be performing as a solo act in Singapore for the first time, across two days this November. The setlist will include tracks from his new album, Piss in the Wind , as well as hits like “Glimpse of Us” and “Slow Dancing in the Dark”.
 Where: Arena @ Expo
 When: 21 and 22 November 2026
 Tickets are available on Ticketmaster . 
 24 November 2026: Khalid - It’s Always Summer Somewhere Tour
 Global hitmaker Khalid is returning to Singapore with his It’s Always Summer Somewhere Tour. Fans can look forward to iconic tracks spanning his career, including “Young Dumb & Broke”, “Eastside”, and his latest single, “Faded Eyes”.
 Where: The Star Theatre
 When: 24 November 2026
 Tickets are available on Ticketmaster . 
 25 November 2026: Guns N’ Roses World Tour 2026
 Legend is not an exaggeration when talking about Guns N’ Roses . Follow them as they revisit legendary hits like “Sweet Child O’ Mine”, Welcome to The Jungle”, “November Rain” and many more. 
 Where: National Stadium
 When: 25 November 2026
 Tickets are available on Ticketmaster . 
 28 November 2026: LE SSERAFIM - ‘PUREFLOW’ tour
 Turn up to celebrate, turn up to celebrate. Mark your calendars, Fearnots, because we’re seeing LE SSERAFIM again! This announcement was dropped shortly after the release of  “CELEBRATION”, the album’s lead single and the anticipation is so real. In the meantime, tune in to the group’s second studio album, ‘PUREFLOW’, Pt. 1 .
 Where: APEX @ EXPO
 When: 28 November 2026
 Tickets are available on Ticketmaster . 
 28 and 29 November 2026: BABYMONSTER - WORLD TOUR [춤 (CHOOM)] IN SINGAPORE 
 Photo: Courtesy of Live Nation Singapore MONSTIEZ, you’re up next. BABYMONSTER is returning with all-new songs like “MOON” and “I LIKE IT” from their latest album, (CHOOM) . Let’s not forget about jamming in real-time to their hit singles “PSYCHO”, “DRIP”, “WE GO UP” and many others.
 Where: Singapore Indoor Stadium
 When: 28 and 29 November 2026
 Tickets are available on Ticketmaster . 
 30 November 2026: Malcolm Todd - Do That Again Tour
 If you’ve been obsessed with Malcolm Todd lately, you’re in luck. The 23-year-old artist will be making his Singapore debut this November, performing hits from his newest album, Do That Again , including the viral TikTok sensation “Obsessica”.
 Where: The Star Theatre
 When: 30 November 2026
 Tickets are sold out on Ticketmaster . 
 17, 19, 20 and 22 December 2026: BTS - BTS World Tour ‘Arirang’
 Photos: Kevin Mazur / Getty Images Entertainment / Getty Images For the first time in seven years, all seven members of K-Pop sensation BTS will be in Singapore for four nights of explosive performances. Time to dust off your Army Bombs and get ready to sing along to tracks from their latest album Arirang , beloved hits like “Idol” and “Fire”, as well as two surprise songs per night.
 Where: National Stadium
 When: 17, 19, 20 and 22 December 2026
 Tickets are sold out on Ticketmaster . 
 8, 9 and 10 January 2027: Jay Chou - “Carnival II” World Tour 2027
 Jay Chou fans, what better way to kick off the new year than with his “Carnival II” world tour? The Taiwanese superstar returns in January 2027 for three nights to deliver an even more electrifying and show-stopping experience, this time with the concept “one city, one theme”. Singapore’s theme couldn’t be more apt—look forward to “Sunny Day Singapore”, based on his hit 2003 song, “Sunny Day”.
 Where: National Stadium
 When: 8, 9 and 10 January 2027
 Tickets are available on Ticketmaster . 
 11 January 2027: Sienna Spiro - My House Tour
 After captivating audiences with her performance at the ArtScience Museum in April, Sienna Spiro returns to Singapore as part of her My House Tour in January. Fans can look forward to another evening showcasing the British singer-songwriter’s remarkable live vocals.
 Where: Capitol Theatre
 When: 11 January 2027
 Tickets are sold out on Ticketmaster . 
 23 January 2027: BoyNextDoor Tour - ‘Knock On Vol.2’
 If you're still feeling major PCD (post-concert depression) since BoyNextDoor ’s last concert in 2025, we’ve got some good news for you. The boy band, consisting of members Sungho , Riwoo , Jaehyun , Taesan , Leehan and Woonhak , will be returning to Singapore in January 2027. In the meantime, tune in to their latest album, HOME , featuring tracks like “VIRAL”, “ddok ddok ddok” and more.
 Where: Singapore Indoor Stadium
 When: 23 January 2027
 Tickets are available on Ticketmaster . 
 12 February 2027: Maroon 5 World Tour - Love Is Like
 Photo: Courtesy of Live Nation Singapore American band Maroon 5 is a crowd favourite—and for a good reason. Since their last appearance in Singapore in 2022, they’re making a return with their Love Is Like world tour. Tune in to classic hits like “Payphone”, “Moves Like Jagger” and “Animals” while not forgetting their latest single release “Heroine”.
 Where: National Stadium
 When: 12 February 2027
 Tickets are available on Ticketmaster . 
 10 February 2027: KATSEYE: THE WILDWORLD TOUR
 EYEKONS, are you ready to put your pinkies up? Global girl group KATSEYE is making their long-awaited Singapore debut this February. Be prepared for a night of electrifying performances as they serve both looks and crazy vocals. From their debut track “Debut” to their latest hit “Hootie Frutti”, we simply can’t wait to be moving like animals on the dance floor. 
 Where: Singapore Indoor Stadium
 When: 10 February 2027
 Tickets will be available from 10 November 2026 on Ticketmaster . 
 20 February 2027: YOASOBI - YOASOBI 10-CITY DOME & STADIUM TOUR 2026-2027 超惑星 “SUPER PLANET” in SINGAPORE
 YOASOBI —the duo consisting of Ayase and Ikura —returns to Singapore for their third show this February with a bigger and grander production. Singapore marks the only Southeast Asian stop on their itinerary, making history as the first solo dome and stadium headlining performance by a Japanese act at the National Stadium.
 Where: National Stadium
 When: 20 February 2027
 Tickets are available on Ticketmaster . 
 6 and 7 March 2027: Stray Kids World Tour - <Run It>
 Wake up, STAYs! Stray Kids is coming back. Fresh off their latest single, “RUN IT”, the boy group is also expected to release their upcoming album, THIS & THAT , this August. With powerful dance moves and unravelled stage charisma, this adrenaline rush of a concert is definitely a must-go for fans.
 Where: Singapore Indoor Stadium
 When: 6 and 7 March 2027
 Tickets are available on Ticketmaster . 
 14 March 2027: ENHYPEN World Tour - ‘Blood Saga’
 Global boy band sensation ENHYPEN will be returning to Singapore for yet another highly-awaited concert—this time, at the National Stadium, marking the group’s first concert at the venue. Time to pull out your lightsticks again, ENGENEs, as they perform hit tracks from their latest album, The Sin: Vanish , including the lead track “Knife”.
 Where: National Stadium
 When: 14 March 2027
 Tickets are available on Ticketmaster . 
 4 April 2027: Beabadoobee - The Powerlines Tour
 Us and a night at The Powerlines Tour? Sounds like the perfect pair. Get ready for Beabadoobee’s return to Singapore this coming April, where she will serenade the audience with tracks from her latest album, Pylon , alongside stunning guitar performances.
 Where: Singapore Indoor Stadium
 When: 4 April 2027
 Tickets will be available from 12 October on Ticketmaster . 
 13, 14, 17 and 18 April 2027: Bruno Mars - ‘The Romantic Tour’
 Photo: Courtesy of Live Nation Entertainment Bruno Mars is heading back to Singapore for four nights with The Romantic Tour, following the release of his fourth solo album, The Romantic . Featuring a special performance by Silk Sonic and with frequent collaborator Anderson.Paak as Pee Wee, buckle up for a night(s) to remember.
 Where: National Stadium
 When: 13, 14, 17 and 18 April 2027
 Tickets are available on BrunoMars.com .
